## Pull request checklist

- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] `./gradlew assembleDebug` passes locally
- [ ] `./gradlew lintDebug` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added / updated (if applicable)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] Public API changes are documented
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits

## Summary
<!-- What does this PR change? -->

## Why
<!-- Motivation + context. Link any related issues (#NNN). -->

## How
<!-- Implementation notes, key files touched, any tricky edge cases. -->

## Screenshots / screen recordings
<!-- If the PR touches the UI, drop a screenshot here. -->

## Test plan
<!-- How did you verify this works? Be specific so a reviewer can reproduce. -->
